title: Hermanus Trail Run 2027
summary: Two days of running in Hermanus: mountain trails in Fernkloof Nature Reserve on day 1 and a beach run along Walker Bay on day 2.
description: Scenic Trails, Sandy Toes, and Fresh air in the heart of Hermanus. Day 1: Fernkloof Nature Reserve - Day 2: Walker Bay Beach. 35km Trail (R1200), 25km Trail (R1000), 15km Trail (R650), 18km Beach (R650). Pre-registration Friday 26 February at Fernkloof Nature Reserve 16:00-18:00.

venue.name: Fernkloof Nature Reserve (day 1); Walker Bay Beach Front (day 2)

profile: The Hermanus Trail Run is a two-day running weekend on 27 and 28 February 2027. Day 1 has 15 km, 25 km and 35 km trails through Fernkloof Nature Reserve, and day 2 is an 18 km beach run along Walker Bay. Entries are open from R650, with combination entries up to R1 750, so it suits trail runners of most levels.
